NMP ships built-ins; the app picks one or writes its own:
- `NeverAutoResolve` — content renderer never fetches; resolution happens only on explicit search/paste (your "only load when the user searches for it").
- `FollowsOnly` — auto-resolve only for notes authored by someone the user follows.
- `WebOfTrust { max_distance }` — auto-resolve within WoT distance N.
- `Always` — shipped but flagged high-risk; most apps shouldn't pick it. [...] (5) Deviations: no EmbedTarget reduction (per your override — full nostr::Filter kept); shared http_get_json is redirects(0) so nip57 no longer follows redirects (security hardening, 147 tests still green); WebOfTrust/FollowsOnly are closure-generic to avoid an nmp-wot dep.
